trigger_start.text:
↹ Move mouse to look 
⬅ Left click to jump 
▲ Hold while jumping to move 
⬆ Middle click to respawn 
ѧ Find bonfires to restore health

trigger_01.text: Banished from your people's planet onto an unknown and strange world, you wake up. The air is thick and full of smog. You notice a well nearby.

trigger_02.text: Wandering deeper into the mantle, you realize; these are the artifacts of a lost civilization.

trigger_03.text: There is no way back. Your family and friends are just a distant memory now.

trigger_04.text: The deeper you go, the more familiar it becomes. Some deep parts of your mind seem to recognize these patterns...

trigger_05.text: Symbols from your childhood. This wasn’t just any civilization. You strangely feel at home here.

trigger_06.text: The world you once knew starts to fade. People forget your name. Forget the names of places you knew and cherished. This doesn't matter to you anymore now.

trigger_end.text: You reach what seems to be the ground. In an instant, everything snaps back.
